title: Concept: Dependency pinned to a tilde range below 1.0
description: package.json declares a dependency ranged with `~` under a zero major version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a dependency ranged with `~` under a zero major version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a dependency ranged with `~` under a zero major version.
